name: GCP Admin
description: Generic Google Cloud command-line capability via gcloud/gsutil/bq — inspect and manage compute, storage, IAM, logging, and services in the operator's project using the VM's ADC identity.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a task needs Google Cloud operations beyond the fleet-lifecycle scripts — inspecting VMs, reading Cloud Logging, checking Cloud Run services, GCS operations, IAM inspection, or any gcloud/gsutil/bq command. Uses the VM's own ADC identity (no keys).
